text: Skip to main content Pay taxes by same-day wire English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In Pay Bank account (Direct Pay) Debit or credit card Your online account Business tax payment (EFTPS) Payment plan Tax debt help Penalties Interest Tax withholding Foreign electronic payments User fees We can accept payment by wire transfer on the same day it’s submitted. Contact your financial institution for availability, fees, and cut-off times. How to pay by wire in the U.S. Fill out the Same-day Taxpayer Worksheet PDF and provide it to your financial institution. To pay for more than one tax form or tax period, complete a separate worksheet for each payment. Your financial institution can get help with formatting and processing in the Financial Institution Handbook PDF . How to pay by wire outside the U.S. Find steps and tax type codes to make foreign electronic payments . Other electronic payment options Pay electronically by bank account, debit or credit card, or digital wallet. Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 22-Jul-2026 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print
